messages:
Sasha: Kicking off a rivet-merge for customer Nyx finetune (nyx-finetune-v3). Short plan: quick smoke + quant sweep (float32 -> int8 -> int4-hybrid). Target evalset: invoice amounts, dates, small code snippets. @Jing please own eval bucket. We'll run on dedicated-nyx pool and shadow on hosted as fallback.

Omar: +1. Please make sure to include the 'amount rounding' set — last merge flipped 12.00 -> 12 in a way that broke downstream validation. Also add comma/locale cases (1,200 / 1.200).

Jing: Added a subset named `nyx_amounts_v2` to the eval runner. Plan: baseline float32 -> int8 (bnb-8) -> int4 (bnb-4) -> int4-hybrid (bnb4-hybrid). I'll capture per-prompt diffs and BLEU/EM-like pass rates.

Sasha: Starting run now. Command for reproducibility: `rwi run --model nyx-finetune-v3 --quant bnb4 --eval nyx_amounts_v2 --workers 8 --pool dedicated-nyx`

eval-bot: Job queued at 1719054400, run_id=rivet-1719054321-1, assigned to dedicated-nyx-03. Will post intermediate progress.

Noah: Heads-up — previous rivet merges had token-offset drift when we applied aggressive KV cache packing. If you see misaligned tokenization, retry with `--sync-kv true` or `--kv-policy preserve-prefix`.

eval-bot: Quick summary (first pass): float32 baseline: pass=96/100; int8: pass=94/100; int4 (bnb-4 default): pass=78/100. Major failure mode: locale/comma handling and rounding heuristics. Examples attached.

Jing: Pasting two representative diffs:
```
Prompt: "Invoice total: $1,200.00 due by 2026-03-01"
Baseline (float32): "Total due: $1,200.00" -> Correct
Int4 (bnb-4): "Total due: $1200" -> semantically OK but downstream parser expects "," -> parse mismatch

Prompt: "Amount filed: 12.00 USD"
Baseline: "12.00 USD" -> OK
Int4: "12 USD" -> loses cents -> validation fails in 9/10 cases with small amounts
```

Sasha: Thanks — that's the behavior I feared. Two mitigations to try: 1) int4-hybrid quant profile, 2) apply a small-scale merge (LoRA graft) with scale=0.7 to preserve decimal handling logits. Also consider forcing tokenizer sync as Noah suggested.

Omar: Can we run targeted warmstart with `--kv-cache-policy preserve-prefix` and a short re-bias step (1000 steps) on the merged head? That helped last quarter for currency tokens.

Jing: Spinning int4-hybrid + kv-preserve runs now. ETA ~30m, will post run_id and diffs in this thread.

eval-bot: int4-hybrid run complete (run_id=rivet-1719054321-2): pass=89/100. Comma/locale issues largely resolved; trailing-cent edgecases down from 9 failures -> 3 failures. Recommendation: Do NOT promote int4 to prod yet. Use int4-hybrid for shadow and keep int8 as prod default.

Noah: +1. File an infra ticket with the samples + logs (tokenization offsets) so infra can look at runtime tokenizer behavior: INFR-5421. Include run_ids and the exact quant kernels used.

Sasha: Filing INFR-5421 now with links to artifacts and sample diffs. Will notify CS for a shadow rollout plan and include the fallback policy to int8 if shadow error rate exceeds 2%. Thanks all :rocket:
